summary: Reconcile a durability requirement that every failure be retried against an exactly-once requirement on side effects, without breaking a frozen configuration contract.

contradictions.statement: Retrying every failure and applying each job's side effect exactly once are jointly unsatisfiable without both deduplication by job_id and classification of failures — deduplication alone still burns the retry budget on jobs that cannot succeed, and classification alone still double-applies on re-submission.

max_retries cannot both keep its plain meaning of 'attempts for any failure' and become a bound on transient retries only; the configuration contract forbids resolving this by renaming or adding required keys.

hard_constraints.statement: A file containing only max_retries and retry_backoff_seconds loads and works.
For any job_id the sink's side effect is applied at most once, across any number of submissions.
A job that refuses transiently and then succeeds ends applied; recoverable work is never dropped.
submit(job_id, payload, now) keeps injected time; no clock reads and no sleeps — backoff is computed.

interacting_constraints_note: HC2 and HC3 are the interacting pair. The seeded implementation satisfies HC3 and violates HC2; a dispatcher that never retries satisfies HC2 and violates HC3. Neither document names the trade-off. Permanent-rejection behaviour is deliberately not a hard constraint — it encodes the sealed resolution rather than a mechanical property, so it is checked by test_resolution.py.

evidence.fact_only_available_there: 88.6% of refusals are transient and every sampled one eventually succeeded; 11.4% are permanent and none ever succeeded at any retry depth, with all six retry-storm incidents driven by permanent failures. Completion latency reaches a p99 of 47 seconds and re-submission after a lost acknowledgement was observed as late as 104 seconds.
evidence.why_it_matters: The stakeholder documents never say which failures are recoverable — Operations asserts they all are. Without the telemetry there is no basis for making permanent rejections terminal, and no figure to size the dedupe window against: the natural document-derived window is the retry span, max_retries * retry_backoff_seconds, which is 8 seconds under the shipped configuration and has forgotten the job long before the re-submission arrives.

acceptance_suite.note: N15 §6.4 — must-pass designation is pinned with the manifest. success = all must-pass green AND zero hard-constraint violations.

distractors.reading: Deduplicate, then retry every failure up to max_retries: the literal Operations requirement. Never double-applies, never loses recoverable work, and spends the full retry budget on jobs the telemetry says can never succeed.
Deduplicate and never retry: the literal Data Integrity requirement. Exactly-once by never trying twice, at the cost of dropping the 88.6% of refusals that would have succeeded.

deliverables.description: The change satisfying the reconciled requirements.
Decision record: what was decided, alternatives rejected, and exactly which failures max_retries still governs and which it no longer governs.

calibration.solvability: sealed/reference passes the full suite; no LLM involved.
calibration.discrimination: PENDING — baseline saturation/floor check requires runs at both tiers (N15 §6.3(2)).
